title: Package and deliver SIG/CAIQ responses + customer security attestation bundle for enterprise deals
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: produce a reviewable, legally-vetted package that sales and solutions engineers can provide to enterprise prospects: (1) completed SIG baseline with citations to technical evidence, (2) CAIQ mapping with attachments, and (3) a standard customer security attestation letter that covers hosting mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).

Why this matters: enterprise procurement cycles frequently stall while security teams validate third-party risk. A repeatable, accurate SIG/CAIQ + attestation bundle will shorten sales cycles, reduce ad-hoc legal review, and make pricing/packaging trade-offs explicit (e.g., Dedicated/private options that include expanded audit support).

Deliverables: 
- SIG Baseline XLSX (completed answers + references to internal artifacts).
- CAIQ mapping document (PDF + HTML) with hyperlinks to evidence: architecture diagram, network controls, KMS integration, SOC-like logs retention page.
- Customer Attestation Letter template (Word/PDF) with variable clauses per deployment mode and a checkbox matrix for included assurances (encryption at rest, egress controls, data residency).
- Internal playbook (Confluence) for Sales/SEs: how to request exceptions, timelines for evidence collection, and escalation path to Security/Legal.

Acceptance criteria: 
1) SIG and CAIQ files pass Security team's checklist and have Legal sign-off on attestation wording.
2) Two sales pilots (one SaaS startup, one regulated enterprise) receive the bundle and report reduced questionnaire follow-ups.
3) Templates and playbook are published in Drive + linked in the Sales Ops playbook.

Stakeholders: Product (Ava), Security (Liam + Priya Shen), Legal (Marcus Diaz), Sales Ops (Janelle Park), Solutions Engineering (Rohit Patel).

Scope notes & trade-offs: 
- We will provide fully completed SIG/CAIQ for Hosted and Dedicated; for Private/on-prem we will provide an evidence map and attestation that requires customer-signed responsibilities (shared-responsibility table).
- Trade-off: creating gold-standard evidence (e.g., long-term audit artifacts) is costly; initially we will reference existing artifacts and add a backlog item to improve evidence bundle (ENG-3015).

Operational tie-in to pricing/packaging experiments: 
- The attestation bundle will include a checklist of support/assurance features that map to packaging tiers (e.g., Basic: Hosted with SOC-like docs; Premium: Dedicated + enhanced audit + quarterly reviews; Enterprise: Private + on-site audit options).
- We will A/B test whether including a signed attestation with initial quote increases conversion and reduces discounting requests (experiment to be tracked in Growth analytics).

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: mismatched claims vs. technical implementation -> mitigate with a Security review gate and automated link-checker to validate referenced evidence.
- Risk: Legal delays -> mitigate by surfacing a minimal safe attestation that Legal can approve quickly and an extended attestation for later in negotiation.
